entries.text: The story is set in a medieval kingdom; the narrative keeps a formal, period voice.

characters.name: Elinor
characters.summary: A courtly scholar who reads maps the way others read scripture.
goals: chart the river roads before the first frost
characters.voice: Scholarly and warm. She never says 'destiny'; she prefers 'the road that made us'.

relationships.notes: Tam guides Elinor's horses on the wall roads.

characters.name: Tam
characters.summary: A blunt gate sergeant who distrusts anything he cannot see from the wall.
characters.voice: Blunt and clipped. He doesn't use contractions, even when angry.

characters.name: Marda
characters.summary: An old ferry-woman who has crossed the ford in every season.
goals: retire before the river takes another boat
